roles.title: AI Fellowship (Winter 2027)
roles.tag_rationale: A cohort programme: which agenda you end up working on depends on your mentor rather than on the host organization, so this is shown under every agenda as well as under the host.
roles.description:
* In this 10-week fellowship, you'll undertake a research project on mitigating catastrophic AI risks, choosing from three tracks: AI Governance, Technical AI Governance, or Technical AI Safety.
* Develop your individual research project under the guidance of experts in your chosen field.
* Engage with ERA's network of researchers and entrepreneurs to build professional connections.
* Receive personalised career support and professional development throughout the programme.

The AI safety unit aims to prevent large-scale risks from the most advanced AI models and systems. They implement and enforce the [General-Purpose AI section of the EU AI Act](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/chapter/5/), a binding legal framework for frontier AI safety and security. In these roles, you will draft legislation, enforce company adherence to their obligations, evaluate AI models and assess risks, foster international cooperation, inform EU member states on AI progress and risks, and strengthen the Europe's position in safe AI.
